programs.title: Landline
programs.desc: Hosted by award-winning journalist Pip Courtney, Landline is Australia's only national agricultural television program covering stories from Australia's rural and regional heartland.

programs.title: Spicks and Specks
programs.sub_title: Emily Wurramara, Claire Hooper, Ella Hooper & Brett Blake
programs.desc: Emily Wurramara, Claire Hooper, Ella Hooper and Brett Blake join Alan, Myf and Adam as they hit such musical heights they have to go into falsetto. There will be R&B, Irish music and some unfortunate innuendos.

programs.title: Anh's Brush With Fame
programs.desc: Lisa Wilkinson is a powerhouse of the Australian media. From her first break as editor of Dolly to life in the spotlight on commercial TV, how will Anh capture her warmth, humility and fighting spirit?

programs.title: Grand Designs Australia
programs.desc: Richard and Erin Sims start out building a farm-style lodge, however it balloons into a building of epic proportions, complete with three 'wings', seven-metre-high chimneys, and thousands of hand-picked dolerite stones.

programs.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programs.desc: Ignoring a puzzling break-in at Station 4, Murdoch travels to Buffalo to help Dr. Ogden solve the suspicious death of a young cancer patient at a children's hospital.

programs.title: Long Lost Family
programs.desc: Carole who 50 years ago met her father, brother and sister for the first and last time has been searching for them since. Samantha grew up in a white family and has not seen her Jamaican father since she was five. (Final).
